description:
You are a DevOps Engineer at TailwindTraders. The Flask inventory management API in the TailwindTraders repository has no CI/CD pipeline — every commit goes to main without automated testing, and bugs like the concurrency issue and SQL injection vulnerability have been slipping through. You need to create a proper CI pipeline.

Your goals:
1. Navigate to the Pipelines section of the TailwindTraders project
2. Create a new pipeline connected to the TailwindTraders repository
3. Configure the pipeline YAML to:
   - Trigger automatically on any push to the main branch AND on pull requests targeting main
   - Use Python 3.11 as the runtime
   - Install all project dependencies from requirements.txt
   - Execute the test suite using pytest on the tests/ directory
4. Save the pipeline definition

The repository already contains app.py, models.py, routes.py, requirements.txt, and tests/test_app.py. Your pipeline should use these existing files.
